blurb: Guests take helicopter flights over Central Florida's famous landmarks such as Walt Disney World, Universal Orlando, and ICON Park. Tours range from 15 to 30 minutes with options for longer flights. Every passenger receives a window seat and headset for communication.
extraNote: Arrive at least 30 minutes before scheduled tour · Late arrivals may result in shortened tour or cancellation without refund · Unfavorable weather may cause rescheduling or full refund · $20 cleaning fee for airsickness outside provided sick bags · Helipad located in Manhattan, accessible by subway, taxi, Uber, or Lyft; limited parking nearby
